scope: Unchanged released decoders of block headers: the TPraos BHeader of Shelley and Alonzo (decoder versions 2 and 5), the Praos Header of Babbage and Conway (7 and 9), each read with decodeFullAnnotator, a Byron epoch boundary header read with decCBORABoundaryHeader at byronProtVer, a header body alone with decodeFull, and a ledger Block holding a Shelley-to-Conway header; definite, indefinite, detached (an empty indefinite list with the fields after it) and non-minimal forms of the header, its body, a VRF certificate, the operational certificate and the protocol version, with the refusals around them and the bounds of the body size and protocol version; chunked issuer keys, refused below version 12, and a Byron boundary header with 200 attributes, which no decoder counts (#749); for each accepted case the header hash over the bytes read, the block body hash of a block, and getSignableRepresentation of the header body, the bytes the KES signature is checked over; and, for a Praos VRF key made of a seed, whether a certificate with its output replaced decodes and passes verifyCertified; no ledger rule or KES signature is checked; the forms of a Byron boundary header's extra data, accepted and refused, and its Genesis tag (#754); Byron main headers read by decCBORAHeader, including an SSC proof of 5000 bytes beyond the former 4096-byte decode budget (#749)

praosHeader.note: HeaderBody and HeaderRaw are RecD records (203-229); getSignableRepresentation re-encodes the body at its major version (113-117)

tpraosHeader.note: BHBody and BHeaderRaw read their fields inside decodeRecordNamed (193-241); getSignableRepresentation (170-171)

ocertRule.note: the TPraos KES check, verifySignedKES over the header body

group.note: CBORGroup reads a list with decodeRecordNamed (27-35)

decCBOR.note: CertifiedVRF reads its list with enforceSize (568-573)
